title: Chillin@Cholla 6 BR 3 masters 12 beds Heated pool
description: Large home with lots of room for fun.  Includes a heated pool and hot tub. There are six bedrooms, 3 bedrooms are master bedrooms and 5 bathrooms. 85” TV inside. 85” and 65” and 50” TV outside. Full bar with 12 stools and sink. Outdoor bbq island with sink and mini fridge. Lots of games to play. Pickle ball/basketball court. Beanbags, Bocce ball, Ping Pong and a Pool Table.
amenities: Private outdoor pool - available all year, open 24 hours, heated, pool toys
